gloss: full account; whole story; details from beginning to end

definitions.gloss: full account; whole story; circumstances from beginning to end
definitions.explanation: The complete sequence of events or details of an incident, especially one involving a problem, accident, or noteworthy occurrence.

examples.japanese: {事件|じけん}の{顛末|てんまつ}を{聞|き}く。
examples.english: To hear the full account of the incident.

examples.japanese: {事故|じこ}の{顛末|てんまつ}を{報告書|ほうこくしょ}にまとめた。
examples.english: I compiled the full details of the accident into a report.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}はその{騒動|そうどう}の{顛末|てんまつ}を{最初|さいしょ}から{最後|さいご}まで{詳|くわ}しく{語|かた}ってくれた。
examples.english: He told me in detail the whole story of the incident from beginning to end.

notes:
Composed of {顛|てん} (top, beginning) + {末|まつ} (end). Literally 'from top to end,' meaning the complete course of events. Often used when recounting problems, incidents, or noteworthy sequences of events.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {事件|じけん}の{顛末|てんまつ}: the full account of an incident
- {顛末|てんまつ}を{報告|ほうこく}する: to report the full details
- {顛末|てんまつ}を{語|かた}る: to tell the whole story
- {顛末書|てんまつしょ}: an incident report (formal document)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {経緯|けいい}: circumstances, background — focuses on the process and reasons; {顛末|てんまつ} focuses on the complete story including the outcome
- いきさつ: circumstances, sequence of events — more conversational; {顛末|てんまつ} is more formal
- {始末|しまつ}: handling/aftermath — focuses on dealing with consequences; {顛末|てんまつ} focuses on narrating what happened

REGISTER:
Formal. Common in business reports, news, and official accounts of incidents.
